title: Radial homotopy formula in degree zero
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ. Let φ be a C^∞ 0-form on ℝ^P (DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0, ContDiff ℝ of order ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)), and let χ be any 0-form on ℝ^P. Suppose χ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^0·dφ(t·x)(x, v) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^P and all v : Fin 0 → ℝ^P. Here d = Mathlib's extDeriv (dφ(y) = alternatizeUncurryFin (fderiv ℝ φ y)) and (x, v) = Fin.cons x v. Then χ(x) = φ(x) − φ(0) for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (φ χ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (v : Fin 0 → Eucl P), χ x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ 0 * extDeriv φ (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → ∀ x, χ x = φ x - φ 0
